concerns.text: FR-001 (Dataset Curation) and SC-005 (Scalability Measurement) lack explicit implementation tasks. While T011 generates puzzles, there is no task to implement the 'deterministic Python verification script' per-puzzle required by FR-001, nor a task to implement the 'characterization of computational complexity class' (empirical log-log regression) required by SC-005. T029d-derive focuses on theoretical derivation, leaving the empirical measurement of SC-005 uncovered.

FR-006 (Exclusion of unparseable constraints) is partially covered by T013 and T019d, but the specific requirement to 'exclude the item from the symbolic-guided run' (i.e., prevent it from entering the BES loop) is not explicitly mapped to a task that gates the BES loop execution (T025). T025 mentions handling 'CONTRADICTION_DETECTED' but does not explicitly cover the exclusion flow for 'PARSE_FAILURE' defined in FR-006.

FR-005 (Two-proportion z-test and t-test) is covered by T029a-impl, but the specific requirement to apply these tests to 'both the symbolic-guided and neural-verifier baseline variants' (FR-004/FR-005) is not explicitly covered. T029a-impl defines the functions, but no task exists to execute the comparison between the two specific variants (Symbolic vs. Neural) to generate the comparative p-values required by FR-005.

SC-002 (Computational overhead measurement) requires measuring 'wall-clock time and energy in Joules'. While T029b-impl calculates cost, there is no explicit task to implement the 'energy (Joules)' calculation using the calibrated TDP (T008c) and wall-clock logs, specifically for the 'neural-verifier baseline' comparison mentioned in SC-002. The task T029b-impl is generic; a specific task to implement the baseline energy comparison logic is missing.

T000c-impl references 'data/raw/curated_logic_v1.json' as the dataset source, but this file/entity is not defined in the spec.md or plan.md data model. This creates a stale reference to a non-existent artifact ID, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle if the file does not exist or is named differently.

T008a-static-data requires generating 'data/raw/cpu_tdp_map.json' from a 'pre-validated, versioned dataset (referencing a specific DOI)'. The spec.md and plan.md do not define this dataset or its DOI. This is a stale tag referencing a non-existent input artifact, making the task impossible to execute as written.
